title: Loved With an Everlasting Love
old_p1: Heavenly Father’s people had been taken far from their homes to faraway lands. Far from home, it was easy to feel forgotten and alone.

Then Heavenly Father sent a message through Jeremiah, His prophet. A prophet shares Heavenly Father’s words. “I have loved thee with an everlasting love,” He said. Everlasting means it never, ever stops.
old_p2: “With lovingkindness have I drawn thee,” He said. Lovingkindness is love and kindness together. Drawn means pulled close, gently, the way you pull a blanket up to your chin.
“Again I will build thee,” He promised. Their land had been broken, but they would be built up again, and the people would dance once more.
That same love is holding you right now in your warm bed. It started before you were born, and it will never stop.
p1: Heavenly Father’s people had been taken far away from their homes. They felt forgotten and alone.

So Heavenly Father gave the prophet Jeremiah a message for them. A prophet shares Heavenly Father’s words. He said, “I have loved you with an everlasting love.” Everlasting means it never, ever stops.
He said He had drawn them close with kindness. Drawn close means pulled near, gently. It is like a mom pulling her child in for a hug.
p2: Heavenly Father made another promise too. He would build His people up again, like a broken house built new. One day they would play their little drums and dance again!
Heavenly Father’s love did not stop when His people were far away. It will never stop for you. Tonight, hug yourself tight and say, “Heavenly Father loves me!”
